summary: commit-driven 维护契约缺口(advance XOR propose)裁定。①契约: committed-impactful 既有覆盖文件改动→update proposal 是目标契约=须修 BUG(依据 UM验收#3/D3/完成定义#3·#4),否决 advance-on-commit/propose-on-working-tree。定性=普通 bug(valid 需求+错 impl,非 valid-impl-仍偏离的 redesign),不改完成定义→控制器可直接 intake 派修、不走需求 redesign。②修复形态: 确认控制器提议——assessFileImpact 对 git-head 事件改用 scanner 已算 commit-range diff(scan.range=mergeBase..HEAD)替工作树 git diff HEAD,之后 LP7 零token抑制照旧(不重开 LP7,只换 diff 源,LP7 从全抑制变精确抑制,正好调和 CG-5+committed→propose)。③范围: UM-followup 伞形内 bug,纯 additive。落点 Core(diffParser.ts:31 getFileDiff/ContentImpactAnalyzer.ts:54 assessFileImpact 加可选 revisionRange,默认 HEAD 保工作树)→Plugin(CommitDrivenMaintenance.ts:82 handleFileChanges(events,scan.range) 透传 + FileChangeHandler.ts:165/275 git-head 传 commitRange,LP7:277-294 logic 不变+订正:279 错误前提注释;scanner range 已产不改)。Core 先 Plugin 后。Design 产契约裁定+推荐形态+落点边界,未改产品码/未 mutate/未 dispatch。
